title: Christmas Light Installation Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for holiday lighting jobs — roofline lighting, wreaths, garland, timers, takedown, and rental programs. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Takedown scheduled for early January — weather may shift the date by a few days.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled holiday lighting line items: roofline lighting, wreaths, timers, takedown, labor
Takedown billed on the same invoice — so clients see the full season price up front
License # and EIN / Tax ID fields — required on client-facing invoices in most states

faqs.q: What should I include on a Christmas light installation invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business and contractor license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list (roofline lighting by the foot, wreaths and garland, timers, labor, takedown), tax, and total due. Note the takedown window — most companies schedule removal for early January.

faqs.q: How do I price Christmas light installation?
faqs.a: The most common model is $8–$12 per linear foot for roofline lighting, installed, with materials included. Wreaths, garland, and tree wraps are priced per item, and takedown is either bundled into the per-foot rate or listed as its own line. A 150 ft roofline typically bills $1,350–$1,800 for the full season.

faqs.q: Should takedown be on the same invoice?
faqs.a: Yes — billing install, materials, and takedown on one invoice avoids disputes in January. If you run a rental program (you own the lights), list the season as a single package line instead and note that the lights remain your property.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
